honesty_note: Numbers here are SEED values for launch day. The nightly workflow counts real receipts from GitHub data. If your tickets look wrong, open a help desk ticket — the tally code is public in .github/workflows/leaderboard_sync.yml and receipts are receipts.
the_point: The leaderboard exists to MOTIVATE, not to rank brothers against each other. Five tickets or five hundred — every brother on this list is moving. The man at the bottom today posts his first PR tomorrow. That's the whole design. GitHub badges, streak culture, DAP energy: the gamification is the on-ramp, the skill is the destination.
